{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max already covers this need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have the second-generation Show 5 and recently added its stand.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would keep using my existing 4K Max instead of adding an HD stick.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a clear need for a tablet, particularly this older model.
ItemID: NA; Title: Soundcore Anker Life Q20 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Headphones, Wireless Over Ear Bluetooth Headphones, 40H Playtime, Hi-Res Audio, Deep Bass, Memory Foam Ear Cups, for Travel, Home Office; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Wireless headphones could be useful with my computer setup, but I would wait until I need a pair.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a fourth-generation Dot, so this older version adds little for me.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would try this to control a lamp through the Alexa devices I already use.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Indoor monitoring interests me given my earlier door alarm purchase, but I would start with one camera rather than three.
ItemID: NA; Title: Apple AirPods Pro; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My history with Mac accessories does not give me a current reason to choose these earbuds.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Studio | Glacier White with Sengled Bluetooth Color Bulb | Alexa smart home starter kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my Alexa setup, but I would try the smart plug before buying another speaker and bulb bundle."}
